prompts.question: Does Saramin show a different address, representative or business description for the company?
prompts.why_it_matters: An out-of-date profile can mislead customers, candidates and partners.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the exact company name on site:www.saramin.co.kr and inspect the top three results for company profiles. Test: 개뿔(최진범 대표자) returns a profile with its representative and Seoul address.
prompts.found_when: A matching company profile has details inconsistent with current verified company details.
prompts.not_found_when: No matching profile in the top three results; absence is normal.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Results are ambiguous, indexed snippets are stale, or profile content cannot be fetched. Confirm legal entity and address before comparison.

prompts.applies_when: Businesses with indexed Wanted company profiles
prompts.question: Does Wanted show an inconsistent company location, founding year or business profile?
prompts.why_it_matters: Candidates and partners may encounter a profile based on data that updates with delay.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the exact business name on site:www.wanted.co.kr and inspect top three results for a company profile. Test: 위하다글로벌 returns company/52477 with location and founding year.
prompts.found_when: A matching profile contains a location, founding year or business description differing from verified information.
prompts.not_found_when: No matching company profile in the top three results; absence is normal.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Results lead only to job postings, name matching is ambiguous, or data is stale or inaccessible.

prompts.applies_when: Businesses listed on Kompass, particularly B2B suppliers
prompts.question: Does a Kompass Korea company profile show inconsistent location, management or business activities?
prompts.why_it_matters: A stale or misclassified listing can mislead overseas buyers.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the exact business name on site:kr.kompass.com and inspect the top three results for a company profile. Test: Comp Korea Co., Ltd. returns its company profile, region, website, CEO and activities.
prompts.found_when: A matching profile contains an inconsistent region, executive, website or description.
prompts.not_found_when: No matching company profile in the top three results; absence is normal.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The match is ambiguous, profile is inaccessible, or a detail requires login or payment. Do not treat a call-routing number as the business telephone.

prompts.applies_when: Employers appearing in the Ministry public wage-arrears disclosure
prompts.question: Is the employer named in the Ministry of Employment and Labor public wage-arrears disclosure?
prompts.why_it_matters: An official public disclosure may affect the business reputation; identify the employer accurately before reporting it.

source.name: Ministry of Employment and Labor wage-arrears disclosure

prompts.how_to_query: Open the encoded company-name URL and read the returned table. Test: 주식회사가인들 returns a matching row; a nonsense company name returned zero results. Record disclosure cycle, employer, business name, location and amount.
prompts.found_when: A row names the business and corroborating location or employer details match; report the disclosure period and arrears as published, not a current conclusion.
prompts.not_found_when: The table explicitly reports zero results. This does not prove the business has no wage arrears.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The page fails, returns an unfiltered list or ambiguous names, or the disclosure has expired. Do not attribute a row on name alone.

prompts.applies_when: Businesses with profiles on THE VC, especially startups and growth companies
prompts.question: Does THE VC show outdated address, representative, founding date or business description for the business?
prompts.why_it_matters: Public company profiles can carry stale information seen by partners and investors.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the exact business name on site:thevc.kr and inspect the top three results for its own profile. Verified searches for 하지요 and 제놀루션 returned their profiles, with headquarters address and representative visible.
prompts.found_when: A profile for the same business gives a conflicting public address, representative, founding date or description.
prompts.not_found_when: No matching company profile is among the top three; this is normal.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Name shared with another business, unrelated result, inaccessible field or login-only information. Confirm entity identity and date before inferring a discrepancy.

prompts.applies_when: Businesses whose executives received the Korean Academic Society of Business Administration strong-small-business entrepreneur award
prompts.question: Is the business listed with a recipient of the Korean Academic Society of Business Administration strong-small-business entrepreneur award?
prompts.why_it_matters: A past award to an executive associated with the company may be a usable public credibility point.
prompts.how_to_query: Read the full 역대 수상자 명단 table, match the business and record the award year and named person. Verified the list names 주식회사 구마에스앤씨(S&C) in 2026 and ㈜AMFM in 2025.
prompts.found_when: The listed company and named recipient match; report this as an award to the person, with the year and company as listed.
prompts.not_found_when: The company is absent from this specific historical recipient table; no negative inference.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Page fails, year entries are stale, or entity/name variations prevent a confident match. The award is to an individual, not necessarily the company itself.

prompts.applies_when: Businesses whose executives received the Korean Academic Society of Business Administration mid-sized company CEO award
prompts.question: Is the business named in KASBA’s mid-sized company CEO award recipients list?
prompts.why_it_matters: A historical award to a company leader could be a relevant public distinction.

source.name: KASBA mid-sized company CEO award recipients

prompts.how_to_query: Read the complete 역대 수상자 명단 table, match the company and record year and recipient. Verified 제너시스BBQ그룹 in 2026 and ㈜아성 in 2025.
prompts.found_when: The company and recipient match; record the award as an award to the named leader with the stated year.
prompts.not_found_when: No match in this specific award list; this is normal.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The page fails, may not be up to date, or the name could refer to another legal entity. A group name does not prove an award to every subsidiary.

sources_rejected.name: Korea Fair Trade Commission case system
sources_rejected.why: The case listing is public, but the host-wide name search was not verified to return a specific listed respondent among the top three; the homepage redirected in testing. Do not infer a clean record from a failed search.

sources_rejected.name: INNO-BIZ company registry
sources_rejected.why: The first-pass name-query parameters were not independently verified against a known listed company. Do not claim an active or expired certification from an untested query.

sources_rejected.name: JobKorea company profiles
sources_rejected.why: Indexed company profiles show useful details, but the page states that unauthorized collection and distribution of posted information is prohibited. Assess permission before automated collection.

sources_rejected.name: Supreme Court Internet Registry Office
sources_rejected.why: First-pass assessment: official registry documents require payment and interactive access; no free name-only automated lookup was verified in this pass.

sources_rejected.name: National Tax Service HomeTax
sources_rejected.why: The business-status lookup needs a business registration number, which the system does not have; no suitable name-only route was verified.

sources_rejected.name: KIPRIS trademark register
sources_rejected.why: No working public name-only GET lookup was verified under the stated automation constraints.

sources_rejected.name: Electronic Gazette
sources_rejected.why: No directly readable, current name-search URL or complete static notice list was verified.

sources_rejected.name: Financial Supervisory Service DART
sources_rejected.why: No qualifying unauthenticated name-based URL was verified in this pass; coverage also excludes many small businesses.

sources_rejected.name: RocketPunch company profiles
sources_rejected.why: Its public site explicitly objects to collection by technical means without data subject consent; permission needs to be assessed before automated use.

open_questions: Test additional Korean local listing platforms for indexed profiles, automated access and coverage.
Determine whether the fair-trade case system has a working unauthenticated name-query GET endpoint and test it against a known respondent.
Find additional broad SME award lists that name companies, beyond KASBA’s awards to individual business leaders.
